title: Finite reduction of the ordinary compactification counit projection
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y and a compactification c of f:X→Y, there exist representative-normalized ordinary/completed tensor models on X,c.Z,Y and ordinary/completed pullback along f [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison, def-sf-pull-completion-comparison]. There are finite tensor models and the canonical pullback compositor at each positive quotient exponent. For every pair of integral constructible inputs K,L, FiniteProjectionEquation [lem-fix-compactification-completed-realization-data] holds: reducing the ordinary proper/open counit projection and applying the compact-support scalar mate, followed by the reduced completed-argument unit, equals scalar tensor comparison followed by compact support of reduction of K, the finite counit projection, and inverse scalar tensor/pullback comparison followed by that same argument unit. This is a finite scalar-extension identity before taking any inverse limit. It asserts neither strict-tower realization nor existence of a completed projection extension.

proof.text: Construct normalized ordinary tensor and completed pullback models on flat-term K-flat complexes; descend the normalized quotient-unit comparisons and choose the corresponding finite tensor models and constant coefficient compositor.

Apply the canonical tensor/coefficient square. Transpose the proper counit projection using its geometric adjunction: preservation of units and counits identifies both transposes. The open tensor comparison restricts to the identity. Paste these squares and use naturality for the argument completion unit to obtain FiniteProjectionEquation.

theorem finiteProjectionModels [QuasiCompact c.i] :
    ∃ (aX : OpenFactorCoherence.Tensor l E X)
      (aZ : OpenFactorCoherence.Tensor l E c.Z) (aY : OpenFactorCoherence.Tensor l E Y)
      (b : OpenFactorCoherence.Pull l E f) (d : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteCoordinates l E c n),
      ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (n : ℕ),
        FiniteProjectionEquation l E c n (d n) aX aZ aY b K.obj L.obj
